scope: Static source/documentation/reference-coordinate review; not full pipeline execution or biological validation
implementation_findings: Prebuilt full CRL references are loaded; the entire machinery is not independently docked for every ternary pose
Target lysine NZ coordinates are measured to a stored point; the point is not dynamically selected as a named Ub terminal atom
ShrakeRupley SASA is evaluated on aligned target alone at residue level; this does not directly measure ternary-induced burial
Line-of-sight excludes atoms by residue number without full chain/insertion identity; adapt for multichain cases
Current clash function examines parsed atoms without explicit heavy-atom filtering
Current accessible-lysine execution is nested inside crl_model_clash branch; verify independent toggle behavior
Finite geometric accessibility and structural hit rate do not establish cellular degradation specificity
recommendation: Evaluate bundled CRL geometry/reference and static-filter functions as a post-docking baseline; preserve existing Ernie docking work and validate mappings/thresholds before integration
